data.one_liner: Show native in-app review popups or direct users to app store review pages.
data.what_it_does: Invokes native in-app review dialogues on Android, iOS, and macOS using official platform APIs so users can review the app without leaving it. It also provides a method to open store listings directly on Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows. In addition, it lets apps check if in-app review dialogs are currently available before prompting.
use_when: You want to prompt users for ratings and reviews within the app flow on Android, iOS, or macOS.
You want a fallback or persistent button that redirects users straight to your store listing without quota limits.
avoid_when: You need in-app review dialogs on Windows, Linux, or Web (only store redirection is supported on Windows, dialogs are unsupported).
You want guaranteed review prompts on every button tap, as underlying OS APIs enforce strict quotas.
strengths: Uses official native review APIs (Play Review on Android and StoreKit on iOS/macOS).
Supports both quota-regulated inline dialogs and quota-free store redirection.
Minimal setup with clear cross-platform compatibility guidelines.
weaknesses: Testing in-app prompts requires specific testing environments (e.g., internal app sharing on Android, and prompts do nothing on iOS TestFlight).
Popups are subject to strict OS-level rate limiting and quotas outside the developer's control.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android API 21+ with Google Play Store installed; iOS 10.3+; macOS 10.14+. Requires app store IDs when calling openStoreListing.
